descriptionHtml:
The IEEE MTTS student Branch Chapter of University of Peradeniya is ready to be a part of the glorious celebration 'Splendour' which remarks the completion of 20 years for the IEEE Student Branch Chapter, University of Peradeniya. The event will be composed of two short talks and a panel discussion which will be held on 22nd of July 2021 from 4.30 pm onwards via zoom under the topic 'Advanced Development of Telecommunication Industry' having five experts of the communication field on board.
The keynote speakers for the event will be Prof.Aruna Gunawardhana and Dr.Himal Uduwawela attached to the Department of Electrical and Electronic Engineering, University of Peradeniya. Prof.Disala Uduwawela of Department of Electrical and Electronic Engineering, University of Peradeniya , Prof.Karu P.Essella of University of Technology, Sydney, Australia and Eng. Tharindu Dayarathne of Arthur C.Clerke Institute, Sri Lanka will be the panelists for the panel discussion.
Hope this event is capable of offering you a rare opportunity to listen the experts of the communication field covering both research areas and industrial applications at the same time.
